::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 11th 1882  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add 46359A f.244
:::

Dear Madam

I see I made a mistake in addressing your letter, as you have left Windsor.  I therefore write again to give my full permission for the translation of the [Questions on the Gospels](cmy_books/cmybook_105.qmd)[^1]

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This translation has not been identified.
